coverage_notes: All 21 supplied observations and three CSV records considered. Registered Table 3 (PDF p.9) and Fig.11 (p.11, also enlarged) visually inspected, plus context on pp.2,3,7,8. Registry plot readings preserved, including disagreements.
shared_qualifications: C1: Nominal atomic/molar coefficients are converted only for chemistry comparison: wt.%_i = 100*n_i*M_i / sum(n_j*M_j), over the complete stated formula. CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights 2024: Al 26.982, Co 58.933, Cr 51.996, Fe 55.845, Ni 58.693, Si 28.085, B 10.81 (https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm). Calculated nominal wt.% is not a measured analysis.
Table 3 parentheses are standard deviations, not observed extrema. CRA minimum/maximum cells coincide with mean minus/plus one SD; this arithmetic does not establish sample minima/maxima.

PDF p.7 defines Ep at current density exceeding 100 microA/cm2 and increasing continually. Al0.7 corrosion is described as preferential/selective dissolution; retain the qualified current-criterion endpoint.
PDF p.3 methods specify 20 +/- 2 C, whereas CRA Test Temp C is 25.0. The discrepancy is retained; Table 3 caption only says room temperature.
Fig.11 black squares have a family legend but no individual Al coefficient or heat-treatment labels. Possible table/plot repetition remains unresolved; candidates are excluded from default joins.
